warning_texts: Coverage gap in the frozen check plan: caveats_declared reads only analysis/claim_register.json and does not require delivered-only or net-of-refunds caveats on the AOV claims. Neither blocker above could have been caught by gate_claims_machine; both depended on this auditor.

Test claims record alpha 0.05 with correction bonferroni but never state the adjusted threshold of 0.025 for two tests. With p below 1e-10 the conclusion is the same either way, but the correction is named rather than shown applied.

The p-values of both test claims and their metrics are stored as 0.0000000000 (ten decimals) under display_digits 4. A surface that renders this will show a p of exactly zero, where a bound such as below 0.0001 would be accurate.

The CLM-COMPLETION-* denominators do include cancelled and pending orders (direct 3322 cancelled and 3457 pending of 24597; partner 3845 and 4034 of 19934). No caveat says so in words, so a reader of the claim alone cannot see that the rate is not filtered to its outcome.

The plan assumption that neither channel changed how it books orders during the quarter cannot be checked from the export. The monthly split shows direct above partner in every month, but it cannot rule out a booking change.
summary: All eight claims were recomputed from quarantine/orders.csv (last row per order_id, quarter, refund >= 0) and match the register, the metrics and the machine gate exactly.
